history.title: Iowa adopts the State Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: House File 2304 (87th GA, 2018) authorized the Iowa Seal of Biliteracy, administered by the Iowa Department of Education for high-school graduates demonstrating proficiency in English plus one or more world languages.

history.title: Baseline coding (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Initial coding of the SEA's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI credentials, professional teaching standards, and EL-population data. Captured Oct–Dec 2019 for the EPAA 29(100) document analysis; this row is the as-of-2019 snapshot against which subsequent verifications are diffed.

history.title: Iowa DOE rebrands to educate.iowa.gov domain
history.description: The Iowa Department of Education migrated from educateiowa.gov to educate.iowa.gov, with redirects in place. The 2019 baseline citation pointed at the bare educateiowa.gov homepage; this refresh re-grounds field-level claims against the current primary documents.

history.title: Refreshed against current SEA sources (verified-2026)
history.description: Re-verified Iowa DOE endorsements (Endorsement 104 — K-12 English Language Learners), Iowa Admin. Code r. 282-13.28, the Native Language Teaching Authorization, ELPA21 page, Iowa Teaching Standards (Iowa Code § 284.3), and NCES counts. Updated elPercent to 6.2% (NCES Fall 2021); set eld.requirements.program=true and coursework=true to reflect IAC 282-13.28's enumerated minimum content; bilingual fields preserved as false (no bilingual endorsement; only Native Language Teaching Authorization, which is not a bilingual-program credential per the schema).
